test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank (ø-no article).

_________ SDO is the head of the sub-division of ___ government organisation.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**SDO**" is an abbreviation that** starts with a vowel sound**, so we use the indefinite article "**an**."
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**a**" before the term "**government organisation**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**a government organisation**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"An SDO is the head of the sub-division of **a government organisation**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "An SDO is the head of the sub-division of"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "a government organisation."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
